description: This file defines the LocalTaskManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing local menu tasks (tabs) using YAML definitions, including loading, caching, and rendering local tasks for routes.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Menu\LocalTaskManager
classes.description: Manages local menu tasks (tabs) in Drupal, loading definitions from YAML, caching, and providing render arrays for route-specific tabs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies like argument resolver, request stack, route match, route provider, module handler, cache, language, access manager, and user.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Returns the discovery object for YAML task definitions, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Validates plugin definitions, ensuring 'route_name' is present.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of a local task by invoking its getTitle method with resolved arguments.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all plugin definitions, adjusting weights slightly for ordering.

methods.name: getLocalTasksForRoute
methods.description: Builds and caches the hierarchy of local tasks (tabs) for a specific route.

methods.name: getTasksBuild
methods.description: Builds render arrays for local tasks, considering route activity and access permissions.

methods.name: getLocalTasks
methods.description: Returns local tasks for a route and level, suspending if data is being built in a fiber.

methods.name: isRouteActive
methods.description: Determines if a given route and parameters match the current request, indicating active status.
